tooltip.vaz2109.controls: W/S - gas/brake, A/D - steer, Space - handbrake (drift), H - horn, R - radio, Shift+RMB - tuning
tooltip.vaz2109.spray.use: Hold right click while looking at a car or a wall to paint
tooltip.vaz2109.spray.palette: Shift + right click to pick a colour
part.vaz2109.bull_bar.desc: Hits mobs twice as hard, even at low speed
part.vaz2109.turbo.desc: +60% acceleration, up to 90 km/h, blow-off pssh
part.vaz2109.radio.desc: Plays music disc tracks. R switches stations
tooltip.vaz2109.part.install: Right click a car to install
screen.vaz2109.not_installed: none - right click the car with the part
tooltip.vaz2109.gun.scope: Right click to look through the PSO-1 scope (4x). Inaccurate from the hip
tooltip.vaz2109.narcoleptin.self: Swallow: for 30 s you doze off (3 s out of every 8) and heal while asleep
tooltip.vaz2109.narcoleptin.mob: Right click a mob: it falls asleep on the spot for 8 seconds
message.vaz2109.car_occupied: Everyone has to get out first
tooltip.vaz2109.gun.auto: Hold left click to fire, right click to aim, R to reload
tooltip.vaz2109.gun.semi: Left click to fire, right click to aim, R to reload
tooltip.vaz2109.melee.crowbar: Right click an iron door or trapdoor to pry it open
tooltip.vaz2109.melee.machete: Cuts leaves, vines and cobwebs instantly
tooltip.vaz2109.throwable.grenade: Bounces off walls, explodes after 3 seconds
tooltip.vaz2109.throwable.molotov: Shatters and sets everything around on fire
tooltip.vaz2109.breathing.water.desc: Right click: dash forward cutting through everything
tooltip.vaz2109.breathing.flame.desc: Right click: ring of fire around you; hits set on fire
tooltip.vaz2109.fox_mask: Breathing techniques recharge twice as fast
tooltip.vaz2109.chainsaw: Hold right click to rev it and saw through mobs and trees
message.vaz2109.empty: Magazine empty - press R to reload
message.vaz2109.car_on_fire: The car is on fire! Run, it is going to blow!
tooltip.vaz2109.skateboard.ride: Right click to step on. W push, S brake, the board carves where you look (A/D sharper), Space ollie
tooltip.vaz2109.skateboard.tricks: In the air: Space kickflip, A/D spin. Grind fences, walls, bars and rails
mask.vaz2109.phil.french: Il respire sous l'eau et nage vite. Bonjour !
message.vaz2109.rufus: Rufus took a deadly hit! (again in 90 seconds)

mask.vaz2109.earl.name: Earl

mask.vaz2109.rufus.ability: Survives a deadly hit every 90 seconds, hard to knock back, but 8% slower
mask.vaz2109.carl.name: Carl
mask.vaz2109.rami.name: Rami
mask.vaz2109.rami.ability: Extra ammo: every fourth shot is free
mask.vaz2109.willem.name: Willem
mask.vaz2109.willem.ability: Hits can knock the weapon out of an enemy's hands
mask.vaz2109.jake.name: Jake
mask.vaz2109.jake.ability: Dangerous throws: arrows and tridents +50%, snowballs and eggs hurt
mask.vaz2109.peter.name: Peter
mask.vaz2109.zack.name: Zack
mask.vaz2109.zack.ability: Combos last twice as long, high jumps
mask.vaz2109.richter.name: Richter
mask.vaz2109.richter.ability: The Makarov fires full auto and silenced, like a silenced Uzi

mask.vaz2109.russell.name: Russell

mask.vaz2109.corey.name: Corey
mask.vaz2109.mark.name: Mark
mask.vaz2109.mark.ability: Dual wields: hold a second gun in the off hand
mask.vaz2109.alex_ash.name: Alex & Ash
tooltip.vaz2109.frostmourne.hit: Hits slow and freeze, every kill heals 2 hearts
tooltip.vaz2109.frostmourne.blast: Right click - Howling Blast: a 12 block wave of frost (10 s cooldown)
tooltip.vaz2109.frostmourne.lore: Whoever takes this blade gains power... and gives it a soul.
chat.vaz2109.arthas.awaken: Who dares disturb the Frozen Throne? Frostmourne hungers for souls!
chat.vaz2109.arthas.rest: None remain... The throne waits again.
message.vaz2109.arthas.harvest_you: The Lich King is tearing out your soul! Run!
chat.vaz2109.arthas.intro1: Icecrown... Only those who seek death come here.
chat.vaz2109.arthas.intro2: I have waited long on this throne. Eternity is so long... when you are alone.
chat.vaz2109.arthas.intro3: Frostmourne hungers. Come closer, and feed it!
tooltip.vaz2109.frostmourne.curse: Curse: the blade hungers even in your pack. It cannot be thrown away. Leave it unfed and it takes control of you
message.vaz2109.frostmourne.whisper2: ...I hunger... feed me, or I will take what I need...
message.vaz2109.frostmourne.fed: ...good... the blade is sated and lets you go.
message.vaz2109.frostmourne.free: You tear free of the blade... but it is still hungry.
message.vaz2109.frostmourne.cling: Your hand will not open. The blade will not let you go.
tooltip.vaz2109.compound_v: Hold right click to take. Wakes a superpower for 5 minutes
tooltip.vaz2109.compound_v.powers: At random: Homelander, A-Train, Queen Maeve, Starlight or Translucent
message.vaz2109.v.homelander: You can fly (double jump to take off) and fire cannot hurt you. V - heat vision.
message.vaz2109.v.a_train: You are the fastest man alive. V - a dash that runs everyone down.
message.vaz2109.v.maeve: An amazon's strength and toughness. V - a ground slam that throws enemies.
message.vaz2109.v.starlight: You see in the dark and heal. V - a blinding burst of light.
message.vaz2109.v.translucent: You are invisible and your skin is like carbon. V - hardened skin (absorbs damage).
message.vaz2109.v.rejected: Your body rejects the serum! It tears you up inside...
message.vaz2109.v.none: You have no superpower. Take some Compound V.
tooltip.vaz2109.ivan_watch.use: Right click - stop time for everyone around (18 blocks) for 5 seconds. 1 minute cooldown
tooltip.vaz2109.explorer_compass.use: Right click - find the nearest boss lairs
message.vaz2109.compass.dimension: The compass only works in the Overworld
chat.vaz2109.ivan.awaken: Oh, guests on my roof! Come on, catch me if you can!
chat.vaz2109.ivan.rest: Boring. Off to train some more.
tooltip.vaz2109.haruta_sword.desc: Kills with this sword store miracles. A fatal blow spends a miracle instead of your life
tooltip.vaz2109.haruta_sword.use: Right click - a dashing cut. 5 second cooldown
message.vaz2109.haruta_sword.miracle: A miracle! You are back on your feet (%s / %s left)
message.vaz2109.timokha.sealed: Timokha is meditating and does not notice you. Beat Ivan Parkour first
message.vaz2109.timokha.unlocked: Ivan Parkour is beaten. Somewhere in the swamps, Timokha opens his eyes...
chat.vaz2109.timokha.awaken: You beat Vanya? Then brace yourself!
chat.vaz2109.timokha.miracle: A miracle! I'm not done yet!
death.attack.vaz2109.sorcery: %1$s was struck down by the supernatural power of %2$s
death.attack.vaz2109.sorcery.item: %1$s was struck down by the supernatural power of %2$s using %3$s
tooltip.vaz2109.timokha_chain: The chain of the last of the trio
tooltip.vaz2109.timokha_chain.hook: Right click - throw the chain: a mob is dragged to you (a boss or anything big drags you to it), a block pulls you there. Right click again to let go
tooltip.vaz2109.timokha_chain.spin: Sneak + right click - whirl the chain: hits everything around (4.5 blocks) and flings it away
message.vaz2109.timokha_chain.sealed: Timokha II hangs in his chains and pays you no attention. Beat Timokha first
message.vaz2109.timokha_chain.unlocked: Timokha has fallen... but somewhere in the badlands chains rattle. Timokha II Chain is waiting.
message.vaz2109.trio.complete: The trio is beaten! Ivan Parkour, Timokha and Timokha II Chain - you got through them all.
chat.vaz2109.timokha_chain.phase2: THAT'S IT!!! NOW IT'S FOR REAL!!!
chat.vaz2109.timokha_chain.cage: NOW YOU'RE LOCKED IN WITH ME!!!
chat.vaz2109.timokha_chain.rebirth: No... the chains... are not broken yet...
chat.vaz2109.timokha_chain.demon: I AM THE CHAIN DEMON!!! AAAAAAAH!!!
tooltip.vaz2109.nanami_blade: Kento Nanami's blunt cleaver, bound in cloth
tooltip.vaz2109.nanami_blade.1: Hold RMB and let go: Ratio Technique. Strikes the 7:3 point of the target you look at: a critical that ignores armour
tooltip.vaz2109.nanami_blade.2: Sneak + RMB on a block: Collapse. The blocks around burst and the debris hits everything near (15 s)
tooltip.vaz2109.nanami_blade.3: Overtime: in the evening and at night the cloth comes off and the blade hits 35% harder
tooltip.vaz2109.nanami_blade.overtime_on: Overtime! The working day is over
message.vaz2109.nanami_blade.overtime: The working day is over. From now on, it's overtime.
message.vaz2109.nanami_blade.workday: A new working day. The blade is wrapped again.
tooltip.vaz2109.playful_cloud: Special grade three-section staff: no technique, only strength
tooltip.vaz2109.playful_cloud.1: The loose sections hit everyone next to the target. A running blow hits harder
tooltip.vaz2109.playful_cloud.2: Hold RMB: the staff whirls round you, battering enemies and knocking projectiles back
tooltip.vaz2109.playful_cloud.3: Let go after a second: all three sections come down at once and throw enemies in the air
tooltip.vaz2109.inverted_spear: Toji Fushiguro's blade that cancels any technique
tooltip.vaz2109.inverted_spear.1: Every hit strips all beneficial effects and absorption and knocks a shield aside
tooltip.vaz2109.inverted_spear.2: Hold RMB and let go: a lunge along your line of sight through everything in the way
tooltip.vaz2109.split_soul_katana: Cuts the soul, not the body
tooltip.vaz2109.split_soul_katana.2: Hold RMB and let go: a drawing cut 9 blocks long that passes through walls
tooltip.vaz2109.dragon_bone: Maki Zenin's blade that stores the force of impacts
tooltip.vaz2109.dragon_bone.1: Hits dealt (+8) and hits taken with it in hand (+12) charge it
tooltip.vaz2109.dragon_bone.2: RMB with 25+ charge: the three engines in the back of the blade fire and hurls you forward through enemies, setting them alight
tooltip.vaz2109.slaughter_demon.1: Quick; cuts deeper into the undead and bosses (+4)
tooltip.vaz2109.slaughter_demon.2: A full-strength blow may become a Black Flash: x2.5 damage, then 15 s in the zone (strength, speed, Black Flashes more often)
death.attack.vaz2109.soul.item: %1$s had their soul cut by %2$s with %3$s
death.attack.vaz2109.soul.player: %1$s had their soul cut while fighting %2$s
death.attack.vaz2109.ratio: %1$s was struck at the 7:3 point by %2$s
death.attack.vaz2109.ratio.item: %1$s was struck at the 7:3 point by %2$s with %3$s
death.attack.vaz2109.ratio.player: %1$s was struck at the 7:3 point while fighting %2$s
tooltip.vaz2109.sukuna_finger: One of the twenty fingers of Ryomen Sukuna, the King of Curses
tooltip.vaz2109.sukuna_finger.1: Only the Vessel class can eat it and live; for anyone else it is poison
tooltip.vaz2109.sukuna_finger.2: Each finger: +½ heart, +0.3 damage, 5% stronger hits on curses
tooltip.vaz2109.sukuna_finger.3: Every finger wakes Sukuna: he takes the body for a while, but lends you his techniques
message.vaz2109.sukuna.vessel: You swallowed Sukuna's finger and lived. You are his vessel now. (%s/%s)
message.vaz2109.sukuna.finger: The King of Curses grows stronger inside you. Fingers eaten: %s/%s
message.vaz2109.sukuna.all: All twenty fingers. The King of Curses is fully awake.
message.vaz2109.sukuna.full: Sukuna already has all of his fingers
message.vaz2109.sukuna.takeover: Sukuna has taken over %s! The markings spread across the face... Run!
message.vaz2109.sukuna.released: You take your body back. Everything aches after Sukuna...
message.vaz2109.sukuna.reject: Your body rejects the King of Curses' finger. You are no vessel: it is pure poison!
message.vaz2109.sukuna.locked: This technique opens after eating %s fingers
message.vaz2109.sukuna.shrine_used: The domain opens only once per awakening
gui.vaz2109.role.title: Choose your class (for good)
message.vaz2109.role.chosen: Your class: %s. The ability is on G (change it in Controls).
message.vaz2109.role.fist: Your next punch is a Divergent Fist
message.vaz2109.role.nothing_to_fix: Nothing to fix: no VAZ nearby, and your gear is whole
commands.vaz2109.class.reset: Class reset for %s players. They will pick again.
message.vaz2109.jogo.domain.name: Coffin of the Iron Mountain
message.vaz2109.jogo.defeated: Jogo crumbles to ash. Something lies in the cinders...
role.vaz2109.vessel.desc: The only one who can eat Sukuna's finger and live. Every finger makes you stronger, but wakes the King of Curses: he takes the body for a while and cuts down everything alive around.
role.vaz2109.mechanic.desc: Knows the VAZ-2109 down to the last bolt. Fixes anything that drives or cuts.
role.vaz2109.mechanic.p2: 25% chance of a second item at the mechanic's bench (not cars or firearms)
role.vaz2109.frog.desc: Half frog. Jumps higher than anyone, swims like a fish and always lands soft.
role.vaz2109.frog.p1: Always Jump Boost II; Dolphin's Grace in water and 15% faster while wet
role.vaz2109.brewer.desc: Brews beer and potions. The belly takes a hit, the head never spins.
role.vaz2109.brewer.p2: Potions drunk last half as long again; beer gives Strength II and heals
message.vaz2109.ability.unlocked: Ability unlocked: %s! Key G, Shift+G to pick.
chat.vaz2109.sukuna.0: At last. This body is mine now.
chat.vaz2109.sukuna.2: How dull... Come on, amuse me.
chat.vaz2109.sukuna.3: Ha ha ha! A few more fingers and the world is mine.
tooltip.vaz2109.quest_book: Right click: the bosses. Quests go strictly in order
gui.vaz2109.quest.title: Quest Book
gui.vaz2109.quest.lair: Lives in his lair: the book tells you where.
gui.vaz2109.quest.comes: Comes to you when you take the quest.
quest.vaz2109.ivan.desc: Runs on walls, leaps across roofs and stops time. Waits in his dungeon.
quest.vaz2109.jacket.desc: A silent killer in a rooster mask. A bat, rushes, Molotovs, and when the phone rings the mob comes.
quest.vaz2109.jacket.hint: His Miami hideout is a pink bungalow with a pool and palms: beaches, deserts, savanna, badlands.
quest.vaz2109.jacket.coming: The phone rings... Jacket is on his way.
quest.vaz2109.timokha.desc: A sword master in his dojo, with frogs and parrots. Dashing cuts and leaps.
quest.vaz2109.andrey.desc: The brewery owner, out on the plains or in a forest: a timber brewhouse full of barrels, a wheat field, a shed and a campfire by the door. Throws bottles of his brew, belly-flops so the ground shakes, and once a fight stops for a drink.
quest.vaz2109.andrey.hint: Find his brewery: plains, meadows, forests, taiga or savanna. He stands behind the bar.
quest.vaz2109.andrey.coming: A smell of malt... Andrey the Brewer is coming to sort you out.
quest.vaz2109.timokha_chain.desc: Timokha is back, with chains. Sleeps in the arena until someone ready comes.
quest.vaz2109.arthas.desc: The last one. Sits on the Frozen Throne with Frostmourne in hand.
message.vaz2109.quest.locked: He will not fight you. Take the quest in the book first: %s
message.vaz2109.quest.not_found: No lair found nearby yet. Try the explorer's compass.
message.vaz2109.quest.all: Every boss has fallen. The book is closed.
tooltip.vaz2109.beer: Strength for a minute, but the head spins
tooltip.vaz2109.beer.brewer: For a brewer: Strength II and healing, no nausea
role.vaz2109.vessel.p1: Sukuna's fingers give health and damage (+0.3 per finger); immune to poison and wither
role.vaz2109.vessel.p2: Eat a finger and Sukuna takes over, casting Fuga, and from 15 fingers the Malevolent Shrine
role.vaz2109.mechanic.p1: Always Haste I: digs and works faster
message.vaz2109.ability.black_flash: 15 fingers: a fully charged Divergent Fist can spark a Black Flash (25%, 45% in the zone)!
tooltip.vaz2109.morgen_phone: Right click: call. Morgenshtern comes for 5 minutes
quest.vaz2109.gaishnik.desc: A traffic police inspector. His whistle stops everyone near (runners more), the radar zaps and marks from afar, and every blow of the baton is a fine in emeralds. At half health he radios for his partners.
quest.vaz2109.gaishnik.hint: Find the traffic police post on a road: plains, meadows, savanna, desert. His white patrol car is parked there.
quest.vaz2109.gaishnik.coming: A siren wails in the distance... Inspector Petrovich is on his way.
chat.vaz2109.gaishnik.start: Inspector Petrovich, traffic police. Breaking the rules, citizen?
chat.vaz2109.gaishnik.backup: Base, base, this is Petrovich! Need backup!
quest.vaz2109.toji.desc: The Sorcerer Killer. Not a drop of cursed energy, only a heavenly restriction: arrows and bullets often miss him, and he is behind you in a blink. Hurt, he draws the Inverted Spear of Heaven, and his blows tear off every good effect.
quest.vaz2109.toji.hint: An abandoned warehouse in a forest, taiga or the hills. Toji waits in the middle of the empty floor.
quest.vaz2109.toji.coming: Someone took a contract on your head... Toji is close.
chat.vaz2109.toji.start: Nothing personal. It's just a job.
quest.vaz2109.mahoraga.desc: The Eight-Handled Sword Divine General. The wheel over his head turns after every 4 blows of one kind, a weapon or a damage type. After that it hurts him less (down to -60%) and he heals a little. Switch weapons! He cuts with the Sword of Extermination and leaps at whoever keeps away.
quest.vaz2109.mahoraga.hint: The ruins of Shibuya: broken towers around a crater. Plains, badlands, desert, snowy plains.
quest.vaz2109.mahoraga.coming: Somewhere behind you a wheel slowly turns...
chat.vaz2109.mahoraga.start: *the wheel over his head turns with a dull sound*
message.vaz2109.mahoraga.adapted: The wheel turned: Mahoraga adapted to %s (-%s%% damage)
quest.vaz2109.gojo.desc: The strongest. Infinity stops arrows and bullets and lets only a quarter of any damage through, but for 2 seconds after each of his techniques it drops: hit him then. Blue drags everyone into one point, Red throws you away, and once hurt he charges Hollow Purple, a beam through everything on its line. Get off the line while he charges!
quest.vaz2109.gojo.hint: Tokyo Jujutsu High: the gate, a stone courtyard, the main hall and cherry trees. Cherry groves, meadows, forests. Gojo waits in the courtyard.
quest.vaz2109.gojo.coming: "Hey, you're the one who beat the Lich King? Let's see..." Gojo is close.
tooltip.vaz2109.armor.tactical.set: Full set: -60% from bullets, -40% from explosions
tooltip.vaz2109.armor.saronite: The Lich King's plate: you never freeze in powder snow
tooltip.vaz2109.armor.saronite.set: Full set: whoever strikes you up close freezes and slows
tooltip.vaz2109.armor.jujutsu: The uniform of Tokyo Jujutsu High
tooltip.vaz2109.armor.jujutsu.set: Full set: +20% damage with fists and cursed tools, always Speed I
tooltip.vaz2109.party_hat: Happy birthday! Every kill in the hat ends in confetti
gui.vaz2109.trial.full_tune: ride a fully tuned VAZ-2109 (all 5 parts)
message.vaz2109.blood.too_weak: Too little blood left to compress
hud.vaz2109.blood.ready: PIERCING BLOOD — hold and steer the jet
message.vaz2109.turret.no_room: No room for the turret here
message.vaz2109.turret.no_ammo: The turret is dry: it needs 9x18 rounds
tooltip.vaz2109.death_painting: A Death Painting womb. The blood of the Kamo clan
tooltip.vaz2109.death_painting.1: Only the Vessel can eat it: +4 hearts, and its blood clots below half health (Regeneration)
tooltip.vaz2109.death_painting.2: Unlocks Piercing Blood: hold the class key to compress blood, then the jet fires while held (costs health)
message.vaz2109.painting.already: The Death Painting's blood already runs in you
message.vaz2109.painting.reject: A cursed womb. Your body rejects it: you are no vessel!
message.vaz2109.painting.eaten: You absorbed the Death Painting. The Kamo blood obeys you now.
quest.vaz2109.choso.desc: Eldest of the Death Painting brothers. Blood Manipulation: Piercing Blood (step off the line while he aims), Supernova up close, blood armour when hurt and Flowing Red Scale at half health.
quest.vaz2109.choso.hint: A half-collapsed house by an overgrown pond: swamps, mangrove swamps, dark and birch forests.
quest.vaz2109.choso.coming: The smell of blood... Choso comes to avenge his brothers.
chat.vaz2109.choso.start: You killed my brothers? Then you don't leave here alive.
commands.vaz2109.test.unlock: All abilities unlocked (test) for %s player(s); cooldowns cleared
commands.vaz2109.test.bosses: All bosses marked as beaten for %s player(s)
commands.vaz2109.test.fingers: Sukuna's fingers set to %s for %s player(s)
tooltip.vaz2109.scooter.ride: Right-click to ride. W kick, A/D steer, S rear brake, Space hop
tooltip.vaz2109.scooter.pickup: Shift + right-click it to fold and pick up
